source.title: Inductive inference of optimal programs. A survey and open problems

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 517034. Direct shell fetching of the zbMATH page returned a Cloudflare challenge rather than readable source text.

zbMATH API metadata identified the exact work as Thomas Zeugmann, "Inductive inference of optimal programs. A survey and open problems," in Nonmonotonic and Inductive Logic, Lecture Notes in Computer Science 543, pages 208-222, Springer-Verlag, 1991, DOI 10.1007/BFb0023325. DOI resolution led to SpringerLink. Crossref confirmed the DOI, title, author, container, pages, and a Springer PDF candidate. OpenAlex confirmed the same DOI and title but reported the work as closed access with no best OA location, no PDF URL, and no repository full text.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged for the zbMATH browser-facing page, plus paywalled_or_restricted or metadata_only for the available Springer, bibliographic, author-publication, and preview pages. Bounded exact-work recovery tried the DOI landing page, Springer chapter and PDF endpoints, Crossref and OpenAlex metadata, DBLP metadata, the author's publication and abstract pages, and exact-title/DOI/book-title searches. Inspected candidates were Springer preview/TOC pages, the author's abstract-only page, DBLP and BibTeX records, Google Books preview/contents pages, Dandelon table-of-contents material, and papers or bibliographies that merely cite the target work. No candidate exposed a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML body containing the technical problem statements.
